A_SCENARIO_ENCODING.explanation: A direct scenario identity (wage, hours, or annualisation) did not survive the host-to-engine mapping.
A_SCENARIO_ENCODING.title: Scenario encoding bug

B_AS_UPSTREAM_VINTAGE.explanation: A Treasury-host-aligned diagnostic establishes a BEFU25-versus-enacted benefit/FTC effect. The statutory primary also retains smaller reg 17–18 host conventions: FTC divided by 52 and the exact JSS cutout.
B_AS_UPSTREAM_VINTAGE.title: Accommodation Supplement compound difference, primary vintage

B_BENEFIT_GROSSUP_TAX.explanation: Treasury taxes wages incrementally above its forecast-vintage grossed benefit. The enacted benefit rate changes that tax base before the same Schedule 1 tax rates are applied.
B_BENEFIT_GROSSUP_TAX.title: Benefit-vintage tax interaction

B_BENEFIT_VINTAGE.explanation: Treasury's BEFU25 TY27 rate differs from the enacted 1 April 2026 rate under Social Security Act 2018 Schedule 4 as amended by the Social Security (Rates of Benefits and Allowances) Order 2026 cl 5.
B_BENEFIT_VINTAGE.title: Main-benefit forecast vintage

B_COMPOUND_NET_INCOME.explanation: At least one material component of net income is a class-(b) benefit or tax-credit vintage difference; smaller class-(c) rounding effects may also be present.
B_COMPOUND_NET_INCOME.title: Compound forecast-vintage level difference

B_WFF_VINTAGE.explanation: The BEFU25 FTC, IWTC, MFTC, or Best Start prescribed amount differs from the amount enacted for 2026/27 under Income Tax Act 2007 ss MD 3, MD 10, ME 1, or MG 2.
B_WFF_VINTAGE.title: Working for Families forecast vintage

C_ACC_ANNUAL_CENTS.explanation: Treasury applies an unrounded weekly 1.75% levy. RuleSpec applies the annual including-GST levy and its whole-cent rounding, then converts the result by 365/7 weeks.
C_ACC_ANNUAL_CENTS.title: ACC period/rounding convention

C_AS_STATUTORY_HOST.explanation: The statutory primary uses the reg 17 annual FTC amount divided by 52 and reg 18's exact JSS vanishing point; raw Treasury uses 365/7 and an annual-dollar-ceiled cutout.
C_AS_STATUTORY_HOST.title: Accommodation Supplement statutory host convention

C_COMPOUND_NET_INCOME.explanation: No established forecast-vintage component is active; the aggregate difference is inherited from documented statutory period or rounding conventions.
C_COMPOUND_NET_INCOME.title: Compound period/rounding difference

C_EMTR_DISCRETE_ROUNDING.explanation: Both sides use the same weekly $1 forward interval. The residual is caused by RuleSpec's annual-cent ACC rounding and, where applicable, the complete-dollar WFF abatement base before conversion back to a week, with any remaining amount bounded by the oracle's six-decimal display envelope.
C_EMTR_DISCRETE_ROUNDING.title: EMTR discrete rounding convention

C_IETC_WHOLE_DOLLARS.explanation: RuleSpec retains the annual statutory whole-dollar calculation before converting by 365/7; Treasury's R flow is continuous weekly arithmetic.
C_IETC_WHOLE_DOLLARS.title: IETC statutory whole-dollar convention

C_NET_WAGE_ROUNDING.explanation: The net-wage residual is the propagation of annual-cent ACC rounding through a weekly value (and, for partner wages, the same conversion).
C_NET_WAGE_ROUNDING.title: Net-wage rounding propagation

D_UNEXPLAINED.explanation: The observed difference is not established by the pinned-vintage or unit/period evidence in this audit.
D_UNEXPLAINED.title: Unexplained

MATCH_SNAPSHOT_PRECISION.explanation: The absolute difference is at most half of the snapshot's six-decimal rounding unit.
MATCH_SNAPSHOT_PRECISION.title: Match at oracle precision
